decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Approval of the details of access,  siting, design and external appearance of the footbridge and the landscaping of the site  (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced
Condition : 2 - Application for approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission, or before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.

Condition : 4 - During construction and upon completion, the proposed structure shall enable repair and 	replacement of any Statutory Undertakers apparatus to be undertaken and shall not inhibit 	to use of excavation plant or lifting machinery if positioned directly above the apparatus 	to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of footbridge adjacent to existing Bedfont Road bridge over Staines - Waterloo railway line incorporating earthworks.  (Outline application).
